// ============================================
// n8n Node: Player Profile Flatten
// player_profile_processing.js → Google Sheets/CSV용 flat structure
// ============================================

// Google Sheets는 flat structure만 지원하므로 변환
// 60개 필드를 모두 flat한 단일 레벨로 변환

const items = $input.all().map(item => item.json);

const flattenedData = items.map(data => {
  return {
    // ========== 메타 정보 ==========
    collection_date: data.collection_date,
    collection_week: data.collection_week,

    // ========== Section 1: Profile Header (18개) ==========
    player_id: data.player_id,
    player_name: data.player_name,
    player_name_kr: data.player_name_kr || '',
    age: data.age,
    height: data.height,
    preferred_foot: data.preferred_foot,
    shirt_number: data.shirt_number,
    position: data.position,
    team: data.team,
    team_id: data.team_id,
    league: data.league,
    league_id: data.league_id,
    season: data.season,
    market_value: data.market_value,
    contract_end: data.contract_end,
    is_injured: data.is_injured ? 'Yes' : 'No',
    injury_status: data.injury_status || '',
    fotmob_url: data.fotmob_url,

    // ========== Section 2: Key Stats Cards (6개) ==========
    matches: data.matches || 0,
    started: data.started || 0,
    minutes_played: data.minutes_played || 0,
    goals: data.goals || 0,
    assists: data.assists || 0,
    rating: data.rating || 0,

    // ========== Section 3: Attack (7개) ==========
    attack_goals: data.attack_goals || 0,
    attack_expected_goals: data.attack_expected_goals || 0,
    attack_non_penalty_xg: data.attack_non_penalty_xg || 0,
    attack_conversion_rate: data.attack_conversion_rate || 0,
    attack_dribbles_succeeded: data.attack_dribbles_succeeded || 0,
    attack_dribble_success_rate: data.attack_dribble_success_rate || 0,
    attack_touches_in_box: data.attack_touches_in_box || 0,

    // ========== Section 4: Passing (9개) ==========
    passing_assists: data.passing_assists || 0,
    passing_expected_assists: data.passing_expected_assists || 0,
    passing_chances_created: data.passing_chances_created || 0,
    passing_successful_passes: data.passing_successful_passes || 0,
    passing_pass_accuracy: data.passing_pass_accuracy || 0,
    passing_long_balls_accurate: data.passing_long_balls_accurate || 0,
    passing_long_ball_accuracy: data.passing_long_ball_accuracy || 0,
    passing_crosses_accurate: data.passing_crosses_accurate || 0,
    passing_cross_accuracy: data.passing_cross_accuracy || 0,

    // ========== Section 5: Possession (2개) ==========
    possession_dispossessed: data.possession_dispossessed || 0,
    possession_penalty_won: data.possession_penalty_won || 0,

    // ========== Section 6: Defense (9개) ==========
    defense_tackles: data.defense_tackles || 0,
    defense_interceptions: data.defense_interceptions || 0,
    defense_blocked_shots: data.defense_blocked_shots || 0,
    defense_duels_won: data.defense_duels_won || 0,
    defense_duel_success_rate: data.defense_duel_success_rate || 0,
    defense_aerials_won: data.defense_aerials_won || 0,
    defense_aerial_success_rate: data.defense_aerial_success_rate || 0,
    defense_recoveries: data.defense_recoveries || 0,
    defense_dribbled_past: data.defense_dribbled_past || 0,

    // ========== Section 7: Discipline (4개) ==========
    discipline_yellow_cards: data.discipline_yellow_cards || 0,
    discipline_red_cards: data.discipline_red_cards || 0,
    discipline_fouls_committed: data.discipline_fouls_committed || 0,
    discipline_fouls_won: data.discipline_fouls_won || 0,

    // ========== Section 8: Shot Analysis (9개) ==========
    shot_total_shots: data.shot_total_shots || 0,
    shot_on_target: data.shot_on_target || 0,
    shot_left_foot: data.shot_left_foot || 0,
    shot_right_foot: data.shot_right_foot || 0,
    shot_headed: data.shot_headed || 0,
    shot_open_play: data.shot_open_play || 0,
    shot_free_kick: data.shot_free_kick || 0,
    shot_penalty: data.shot_penalty || 0,
    shot_preferred_foot_ratio: data.shot_preferred_foot_ratio || 0
  };
});

return flattenedData.map(data => ({ json: data }));
